title: The Poles' new ending: Act 2 and the whole script
kaylee: Hold Pebble and he sings Papa's song: a glowing ring rolls across the dark snow, every friend it finds joins in, and the biggest song crosses Antarctica until Papa sings back.
questions: Holding Pebble: does the ring grow too fast, about right, or too slow? (The feel lab link has the sliders.)
The friends sing along as little made-up voices (Terry whistles, the whale moans). Cute, or too beepy?
The ending's script: is there a line that sounds wrong? Name it, or say fine.
